items.title: Make control assets and Story metadata reachable and branch-local in an externally provisioned linked worktree
items.context: Use one explicit root-source model for primary controller inputs and worktree snapshots; never git-add a path outside the Story worktree.
items.userSees: Story commands run from the linked worktree without metadata auto-commit or missing-config deadlocks.

happy.desc: A linked-worktree Story command persists and commits its Story artifact using a branch-local projection while reading the authoritative controller configuration.

edge.desc: A controller-only configuration snapshot is digest-bound and available to worktree discovery without following unsafe paths.

adversarial.desc: A foreign or escaping metadata path remains rejected and cannot be staged into the Story branch.

items.title: Add a reachable Go verification profile for enforced pre-review
items.context: Use verifier-executed registered Go commands and freshness bindings for generic acceptance; do not claim TypeScript process-fact topology or fabricate mutation evidence.
items.userSees: A Go Story with current passing registered go test evidence can enter REVIEW; missing, failing, or stale evidence remains blocked.

happy.desc: An enforced Go Story with a current successful registered go test receipt passes the applicable pre-review gate.

edge.desc: Stale or mismatched registered Go verification evidence fails pre-review.

adversarial.desc: Missing or failing Go verification evidence cannot advance to REVIEW.

items.title: Preserve TypeScript high-assurance gates and register the new process facts
items.context: Run legacy topology/mutation smokes and update process-fact contracts and the decision document for capability-aware applicability.
items.userSees: Existing TypeScript ProofStory enforcement continues to require complete topology and biting mutations.

happy.desc: Existing TypeScript pre-review and acceptance-basis suites remain green.

adversarial.desc: Removing required TypeScript mutation proof still blocks enforced pre-review.
